2026-2027.summary: Broadway League data for the week of August 23, 2026 shows divergent momentum across Bushnell's 2026-2027 slate: Hell's Kitchen experienced a sharp 62% gross decline with paid capacity plummeting from high to low band, signaling potential post-summer softness, while The Outsiders surged 41% into high-capacity territory and The Great Gatsby posted modest 17% growth. The bifurcated performance suggests selective audience engagement rather than broad touring market weakness.
